claim: The scheduler's sleep unit is 16 msec: *A=SLEEP TIME X 16MSEC — the author's nominal 60 Hz tick.
NAPP 60 is commented SLEEP 1 SECOND — sixty 16-msec ticks to the author's second, the nominal-60 model in the author's own words.
The IRQ dispatches on the beam position: LDA VERTCT, commented PAST 128, compared with 128 — the sub-128 arm is the once-per-frame arm.

claim: The sub-128 IRQ arm increments the frame counter: INC TIMER — once per frame.
The executive spins on the frame counter: EXEC0 LDA TIMER (then BEQ EXEC0 / CLR TIMER) — the mainloop gate.
When the executive falls behind it degrades rather than slows: *OVERLOAD WIPE OUT A GUY — the overload path culls objects.
